annotations.title: Confirm, pause, resume, retarget or cancel a price watch from its mail link

description: The buttons of /{locale}/hlidac, one action on the one watch the signed token names, no sign-in: `confirm` (only the confirmation token of watch_product_price: the person's double opt-in click, an agent passes it only on the person's word), `pause` / `resume`, `set_target` with `target_total` (in the watch's currency; null = any real drop) and `cancel` (deletes the watch and its trigger history; switched off in one call, repeated calls answer status cancelled). The pause link is also the List-Unsubscribe one-click address of every alert. Answers the watch as price_watch_status shows it.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.

t.description: The `t` parameter of the link in a price-watch mail (/{locale}/hlidac?t=…): the signed token of that one watch.

target_total.description: For set_target: the new limit in the watch's currency (goods + shipping); null = any real drop under the saved total.
